summary: Frontend-only validation of the two new Founder UI pages — Creative Assets (/creative-assets, STD-UCAMS-0001) and Publication Governance (/publication-governance, STD-PUB-0001). Logged in as demo.admin@qru.com, exercised all requested click flows against BOOK-0020. Every scenario listed in the review passed end-to-end.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — a hydration warning caused by wrapping option content. Cosmetic only, does not affect functionality; suggest keeping <option> children as plain text.

creative_assets.spec_generation: ca-genspec-qru_online_primary → ca-spec-panel appeared with spec_id UCAS-10368e519a13 and checksum badge; success toast triggered

creative_assets.approve_lock_lifecycle: ca-approve then ca-lock transitioned asset to 'Locked' after refresh (verified via badge text)
creative_assets.marketplace_package_etsy: ca-pkg-etsy → ca-package-result shows 'Not Ready', Policy: Review Ready, Decision: BLOCKED, Missing: marketplace_image — correct pre-approval behaviour

publication_governance.decision_badges: All 5 destinations show BLOCKED with mode badge (Authorized Auto Publish / Review Ready) and 'from enterprise:QRU' resolved-from
publication_governance.missing_requirements: pg-missing-<dest> shown for every destination listing constitutional gaps (Knowledge Verified, Rendering Passed, ...)
publication_governance.publish_buttons_disabled: All 5 pg-publish-<dest> buttons are disabled (auto_publish_authorized=false) — correct governed behaviour
publication_governance.policy_override_product_etsy_auto_publis: Set policy → toast 'Policy set: etsy → Authorized Auto Publish' — etsy card mode badge updated to 'Authorized Auto Publish' with resolved-from 'product:<book_id>' after auto-reload
publication_governance.history_panel: pg-history renders with empty-state message 'No publication attempts yet.'

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Fix React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in both CreativeAssets.js and PublicationGovernance.js product <select>. Currently options are pure text — the warning appears to come from another page component (search bar or dropdown) triggered on route change. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: CreativeAssets.js and PublicationGovernance.js are well-scoped, use data-testid consistently, and correctly call backend APIs via the axios interceptor with Bearer token from localStorage.
Success toasts on upload use v.result to pick between success/error which is a nice UX detail.
Package result correctly surfaces policy mode, decision, and missing assets — matches governed publication contract.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 spec (UCAS-10368e519a13) and 1 creative asset (CA-78e8fc40bed8) on product BOOK-0020, then transitioned asset to Locked. Set product-scope policy override: BOOK-0020 / etsy → Authorized Auto Publish. No publication history was created (publish remained blocked per constitution).
